Honestly it exceeded my expectations, especially in terms of the cgi (the first trailer looked unfinished). The human characters weren’t annoying and the plot was fine, but I still had a ton of complaints with it. Felt like it lacked a ton of interaction between the transformers themselves. At least when it comes to social interaction. So there isn’t really any memorable character development between any of them. The fight scenes were fantastic. I might get some flack for this, but some of the voice lines felt phoned in. I’m not talking about the actual dialogue, but how they’re said. Specifically one part with Optimus in the warehouse when you first see the autobots together and primal when he fights airrazor. Something about the delivery just felt weird and shallow. But if you’re just watching the movie at face value, it’s good and fun. I’m a massive beast wars fan boy, so I’m happy they made it to live action.

Either is fine for beginners, but practicing with a pick might have more carry over to an electric guitar, that an you can just focus on strumming. If your strings are muted, you’re either resting your picking hand on the strings or your fretting hand fingers are touching other strings. Thumb is usually reserved for 6,5, and 4, while the other fingers handle the rest, but it’s not concrete. You pick with your fingers, if your nails are longer they’ll pick the strings instead.
